description: Component for micro-batch MySQL CDC via the binary log (binlog).

outputs.description: Sensor run requests carrying a batch of insert/update/delete row changes

username.label: Username
username.description: MySQL username with REPLICATION SLAVE and REPLICATION CLIENT privileges

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the MySQL password

ssl_disabled.label: Ssl Disabled
ssl_disabled.description: Disable TLS for the binlog connection. Default False (TLS required); set True only for trusted local networks.

server_id.label: Server Id
server_id.description: Unique integer (1 to 2^32-1) this sensor presents to the MySQL server as a replication client id. Must not collide with any other replica or binlog consumer connected to this server -- including another instance of this same sensor, if you ever run more than one against the same database.

database.label: Database
database.description: Which MySQL schema/database to track. This sensor tracks exactly ONE schema -- declare one sensor per schema if you need more than one. (MySQL's own binlog-protocol table/schema filters match on bare names, not schema-qualified ones, so tracking several schemas from one sensor risks a table-name collision silently matching the wrong schema's table.)

table_patterns.label: Table Patterns
table_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (e.g. 'orders', 'order_items_*') matched against bare table names within `database`. Resolved against INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES at the start of every tick (not cached), so a new table matching a wildcard is picked up automatically on its next tick -- no restart required.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when changes are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

max_events_per_tick.label: Max Events Per Tick
max_events_per_tick.description: Caps how many row-change events this sensor processes in one tick, even if more remain before it would otherwise report 'caught up'. Protects a single run from an enormous backlog (e.g. first run against a server with days of retained binlog). Unset (default): no cap, processes everything available until caught up. When the cap is hit, position is persisted only through the last event actually processed -- the remainder is picked up on the next tick.

position_mode.label: Position Mode
position_mode.description: 'binlog' (default) -- resume from a stored binlog file+position. 'gtid' -- resume from a stored GTID set via the server's auto-position mechanism. Requires gtid_mode=ON and enforce_gtid_consistency=ON on the MySQL server -- this sensor does NOT auto-detect whether GTID mode is enabled; selecting 'gtid' against a server without it fails loudly via skip_reason instead of silently falling back.

on_first_run.label: On First Run
on_first_run.description: 'start_now' (default) -- skip all historical binlog and start capturing changes from the server's CURRENT position on the very first tick. Pair with a separate one-time snapshot/full-load of existing rows (e.g. this registry's own full-table ingestion components) -- this sensor is the ongoing-changes half of a CDC pipeline, not an initial-load mechanism. 'from_beginning' -- start from the EARLIEST binlog file the server still retains. Fails loudly if that file has already aged out under the server's binlog retention settings -- rarely useful outside small/test servers with long retention.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`. Defaults to 'config' for backward compat with other sensors in this registry; set to the real op/asset name if it's not literally 'config'.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields changes. Metadata includes database, tables, event_count, inserts, updates, deletes, log_file, log_pos.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), emit AssetMaterialization on the target asset key. External assets show healthy/green in the Dagster UI and downstream AutomationCondition.eager() fires naturally on parent updates. When False, emit AssetObservation -- free of Dagster+ credit charges, but downstream conditions that gate on ~any_deps_missing() (including eager()) will not fire.
